jobs.title: Vice President of Finance
jobs.description:
ABOUT MARIANA MINERALS

Mariana Minerals is a software-first, vertically integrated minerals company on a mission to supply the critical minerals powering modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. We’re reimagining the minerals supply chain by combining deep industry expertise with advanced software, automation, and data-driven decision-making.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Vice President of Finance to lead and scale Mariana Minerals' existing Accounting and FP&A team as we grow from two capital-intensive flagship projects today toward a broader portfolio of commercial mining and mineral-processing operations. Reporting to the Co-Founder & Chief Financial Officer, this role owns the finance organization's execution end to end — technical accounting, close, audit, and controls on one side; budgeting, forecasting, and cross-functional business partnering on the other.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical accounting expertise with strong strategic and people leadership, and has scaled a finance function before at a capital-intensive, high-growth company. As Mariana continues to grow, this role will play a key part in strengthening internal controls, building financial infrastructure, and preparing the company for its next stage of growth.

This role will work closely with the CEO, CFO, project leadership, and the board, and will lead Mariana's existing Accounting and FP&A staff across multiple operating locations.



What You'll Do

FP&A & Strategic Finance

 - Lead company-wide budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning across corporate and project-level P&Ls – particularly in the form of development and management of Mariana’s internally-developed FP&A tools and BizOs software platform.

 - Partner directly with the CEO, CFO, and project leadership on capital allocation, unit economics, and project-level financial modeling for Lithium One, Copper One, and future sites.

 - Own board and investor reporting, including monthly and quarterly board packages, investor updates, and ad hoc requests from Mariana's investor base.

 - Build the financial infrastructure, reporting cadence, and KPIs needed to support Mariana's plan to stand up ten commercial projects over the next decade.

Accounting & Controllership

 - In conjunction with Mariana’s Controller, own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close process, ensuring accurate, timely, and audit-ready financials across all entities and projects.

 - Serve as the primary point of contact for external auditors and tax advisors; manage the annual audit process end to end.

 - Set and maintain technical accounting policy, including capitalized project costs, inventory and commodity accounting, revenue recognition, and foreign currency, as operations scale.

 - Build and strengthen internal controls and financial systems in anticipation of future capital raises and eventual public-company readiness.

 - Oversee treasury and cash management across a balance sheet funded by venture capital and project-level capital structures.

Team & Systems Leadership

 - Lead, coach, and develop Mariana's existing Accounting and FP&A team as headcount and project count scale.

 - Evaluate and implement finance systems and tooling, including ERP and planning tools, to replace manual processes as transaction volume and complexity increase.

 - Represent finance in cross-functional planning with Engineering, Operations, Legal, and Talent as Mariana scales its corporate functions.

 - Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, reporting, and automation across the finance organization.



Desired Qualifications

 - 10+ years of progressive finance and accounting experience, including senior leadership spanning both accounting/controllership and FP&A.

 - A track record of scaling a finance function at a capital-intensive, high-growth company, such as hardware, industrials, energy, or mining, ideally through a period of significant fundraising or capital deployment.

 - Strong understanding of GAAP and core accounting principles; CPA or equivalent technical accounting credential strongly preferred.

 - Direct experience owning external audit relationships and board or investor reporting.

 - Experience building or upgrading financial systems and processes as a company scales.

 - Experience with ERP or accounting systems and financial planning tools.

 - Background in natural resources, energy, infrastructure, or other capital-intensive businesses is a plus.

 - Experience partnering with government or regulated-industry stakeholders is a plus.

 - Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.


OUR CULTURE IS BUILT ON FOUR PRINCIPLES:



Everyone Gets Home Safe. We never put speed or cost ahead of people.

Extreme Ownership. We take full responsibility for outcomes, relentlessly driving toward solutions.

Engineer Out Requirements, then Automate. We simplify, optimize, and then automate for scale.

Share Your Legos. We collaborate openly, share knowledge, and empower each other to build bigger, better solutions.



Join us as we build the future of responsible mineral sourcing and supply!

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT MARIANA MINERALS

Mariana Minerals is a software-first, vertically integrated minerals company on a mission to supply the critical minerals powering modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. We’re reimagining the minerals supply chain by combining deep industry expertise with advanced software, automation, and data-driven decision-making.

The Role

Mariana Minerals is looking for a Business Operations Manager to lead operational strategy and business performance management for its Lithium business, based out of Mariana's Houston or San Francisco office. This role sits at the intersection of Finance, Business Development and Operations — translating operational performance into financial insight and helping leadership make faster, better-informed decisions.

What You’ll Do

 - Financial and Operational performance management: Own the business performance framework for the Lithium business — integrating operational KPIs with financial metrics to give leadership a clear view of cost, production, and margin performance against plan.

 - FP&A partnership: Work closely with the Finance team to support budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis. Build the operational context behind the numbers and help translate field data into finance-ready reporting.

 - Greenfield project development operations: Partner with the Business Development team to build the processes, playbooks, and tracking systems that govern how projects advance from origination through definitive feasibility study (DFS) and into construction.

 - Business process improvement: Identify and drive improvements across operational and corporate functions, including finance, supply chain, and HSE. Design scalable processes that support growth without adding unnecessary overhead. Lead the company's ISO 9001 certification effort.

 - Digitization and reporting infrastructure: Partner with Mariana's software and data teams to build and improve the reporting systems and digital tools that support operations. Ensure data flows cleanly from the field to the boardroom.

 - Executive reporting and communications: Own the cadence of leadership reporting, ensuring leadership always has the information they need, when they need it.

Qualifications

 - 5-10+ years in business operations or program management; experience in energy, chemicals, manufacturing, or another industrial sector is a plus

 - Demonstrated ability to build and own operational reporting systems (define KPIs, design dashboards, implement data collection workflows)

 - Experience implementing or maintaining a quality management system; familiarity with ISO 9001 or similar frameworks preferred.

 - Able to build operational structure around the technical and commercial work of others

 - Strong communicator with experience distilling complex operational issues into clear updates for leadership and keeping distributed teams aligned

 - Proven track record leading cross-functional projects in fast-moving environments with minimal oversight

 - Experience working directly with frontline operations and executive leadership; comfortable influencing without authority across all levels

 - Comfortable on-site in an industrial environment; this is a full-time, in-person role in Houston, TX

jobs.title: Procurement Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT MARIANA MINERALS

Mariana Minerals is a software-first, vertically integrated minerals company on a mission to supply the critical minerals powering modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. We’re reimagining the minerals supply chain by combining deep industry expertise with advanced software, automation, and data-driven decision-making.

Mariana is hiring a Procurement Manager to own procurement for our new projects and pre-operational sites. This is a senior, self-directed role requiring deep technical and commercial experience in industrial procurement.

In this role, you will ensure sites have the supply agreements, vendor relationships, and procurement coverage they need before they go live. You will work across engineering, operations, and commercial functions to translate project needs into executed contracts, and identify sourcing opportunities across the portfolio. This role covers operating supplies, consumables, and non-construction capital spend. Construction and fixed equipment procurement are owned by the Capital Projects team.

What You’ll Do

 1. Work directly with engineering and technical teams to define procurement requirements for pre-operational sites; translate technical specifications into sourcing scope

 2. Own end-to-end pre-operational procurement: qualify vendors per established policy frameworks, run RFQ and competitive bid processes, negotiate pricing and contract terms, execute purchases, manage first deliveries

 3. Procure operating supplies and consumables (including reagents and spare parts) and non-construction capital spend (including mobile equipment)

 4. Ensure all contracts are reviewed for policy compliance and enterprise-level alignment prior to execution; flag clauses with broader implications

 5. Own vendor relationships through the pre-operational phase; ensure clean handoff to on-site procurement as sites become operational

 6. Support on-site procurement on complex purchases, high-value negotiations, and new project scope at existing operational sites

 7. Lead cross-site consolidation sourcing events to identify and capture volume-based savings opportunities

 8. Contribute quote data and supplier information to the organization's pricing and market intelligence database

 9. Coordinate across site and project teams to ensure continuity of supply through startup and into operations



Desired Qualifications

 1. Bachelor's degree in engineering, materials science, chemistry, or a related technical field required. Candidates without a degree who can demonstrate equivalent technical depth through experience will be considered.

 2. 8-12+ years of experience in procurement, project procurement, or capital purchasing in mining, industrials, chemicals, or a related sector

 3. Proven track record of owning pre-operational or greenfield site procurement from spec to first delivery

 4. Strong technical background with the ability to read specifications, understand process requirements, and engage credibly with engineering teams

 5. Excellent negotiation skills with a track record of securing favorable terms under time pressure and without a large team behind you

 6. Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple concurrent procurement workstreams across different projects and sites

 7. Comfortable operating with ambiguity and limited structure; takes ownership and figures it out

 8. Proficient with software tools for project tracking, workstream management, and reporting

jobs.title: Sr. Procurement Specialist - Process Equipment
jobs.description:
ABOUT MARIANA MINERALS

Mariana Minerals is a software-first, vertically integrated minerals company on a mission to supply the critical minerals powering modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. We’re reimagining the minerals supply chain by combining deep industry expertise with advanced software, automation, and data-driven decision-making.


ROLE OVERVIEW

Mariana Minerals seeks a hands-on, commercially savvy Sr. Procurement Specialist – Process Equipment to drive capital project delivery by overseeing end-to-end procurement of capital equipment. This role isn’t about transactional purchasing—here, you’ll manage defined procurement scopes from strategy development through contract award and execution, directly impacting project schedules and capital efficiency.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO


OWN CAPITAL PROCUREMENT WORKSTREAMS

 - Lead pre-award, award, and post-award contracting activities for capital equipment purchases

 - Develop and execute procurement strategies aligned with project timelines and critical path needs

 - Drive commercial negotiations with focus on total cost, risk allocation, and delivery certainty

 - Support PO conversion, approvals, and procurement system processing


MANAGE CONTRACTS & COMMERCIAL RISK

 - Draft, review, and negotiate NDAs, MSAs, and equipment purchase agreements

 - Coordinate change orders and commercial amendments with project teams

 - Ensure documentation is structured, defensible, and audit-ready


DRIVE COST & VALUE

 - Analyze spend data and identify cost savings or value-creation opportunities

 - Foster competition in the supplier market

 - Conduct commercial risk assessments to minimize supply chain and schedule risks


BUILD BETTER SYSTEMS

 - Help design scalable procurement processes as Mariana Minerals grows

 - Improve cycle times and streamline sourcing and approval workflows

 - Contribute to establishing a disciplined, data-driven procurement function from the ground up

 


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 5–7+ years of procurement experience in equipment purchasing and heavy industry

 - Proven experience managing competitive sourcing processes for capital equipment

 - Strong contract negotiation skills

 - In-depth understanding of commercial risk allocation

 - Proficiency with ERP/procurement systems and structured documentation
